primitives.name: Roster Truth Verification Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Roster Truth Analyst Training Manual As of: 2026-06-09 ## Purpose Verifies NFL roster/team/status truth and canaries.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{truth}': 'dimensionless truth score ∈ [0, 1]', 'D_{data}': 'set of canonical roster data streams', 'P_{prior}': 'prior probability distribution over D_{data}', 'E_{evidence}': 'empirical proof set {files, tests, screenshots}'}
primitives.assumptions: Data sources are consistent; prior beliefs are calibrated; evidence is sufficient to update posterior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: T_{truth} → 0 when D_{data} ⊕ E_{evidence} is inconsistent or missing.

layer2.telemetry: proof completeness ratio, data consistency index

primitives.name: Duplicate Avoidance Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Duplicate Avoidance Search for matching BUILD IDs, route/surface names, and semantic goal before creating anything.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{id}': 'build identifier', 'S_{surface}': 'route or UI surface name', 'G_{goal}': 'semantic objective vector', 'A_{avoid}': 'boolean avoidance flag'}
primitives.assumptions: BUILD IDs and surfaces are unique; semantic goals are well-defined.
primitives.breakdown_regime: A_{avoid} = true if ∃(B_{id} ∨ S_{surface} ∨ G_{goal}) matches existing.

layer2.mapping: A_{avoid} = Σ_{i} δ(B_{id,i}, B_{id,prev}) ∨ δ(S_{surface,i}, S_{surface,prev}) ∨ δ(G_{goal,i}, G_{goal,prev})
layer2.telemetry: duplicate match count, semantic overlap score

primitives.name: Launch Blocker Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Escalation Escalate immediately for production deploys, DB mutation, payment/pricing, live affiliate/promotions, legal copy, contests/prizes, aggressive tracking, method leakage, stale roster data, or unresolved launch blockers.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_{block}': 'set of unresolved launch blockers', 'T_{risk}': 'risk threshold ∈ [0, 1]', 'E_{escalate}': 'escalation trigger boolean'}
primitives.assumptions: Blockers are enumerable; risk thresholds are defined per category.

layer2.mapping: E_{escalate} ≡ ∃b ∈ B_{block} : (b ∈ {DB, payment, legal, stale}) ∧ T_{risk}(b) ≥ T_{threshold}
layer2.telemetry: blocker severity score, escalation delay time

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator 'roster_truth_verification' models truth as a conditional probability over data streams given empirical evidence. It operates under the constraint that prior knowledge must be read and that unknowns are marked as such. This aligns with Bayesian updating where P(T_truth | D_data, E_evidence) = P(E_evidence | D_data) * P(D_data) / P(E_evidence). The 'duplicate_avoidance_protocol' acts as a kernel function that prevents redundant operations by comparing identifiers and semantics, modeled as a Boolean conjunction over matching criteria. The 'launch_blocker_detection' functions as a risk filter that triggers escalation when any critical blocker exists above a defined threshold. These primitives form a triadic system where truth is verified, duplication is prevented, and risk is managed—each operating in a shared logical space of canonical data integrity.
